title: High strength-ductile lightweight Al-Ti-Zr-Nb-Ta refractory high-entropy alloy via laser directed energy deposition
process_description: prepared by plasma rotating electrode process (PREP) to obtain pre-alloyed powder, followed by laser directed energy deposition (LDED) with optimal parameters: laser power 1600 W, scanning speed 400 mm/min, powder feed rate 4 g/min, protective gas flow rate 4-8 L/min, and layer height 1.5 mm.

title: High strength-ductile lightweight Al-Ti-Zr-Nb-Ta refractory high-entropy alloy via vacuum copper mold casting
process_description: prepared by vacuum copper mold casting using high-purity elemental particles as raw materials.
